sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The present application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime No. 2057C of 2010, under Sections 409,420,120B I.P.C., P.S.- Kotwali Nagar, District- Raebareli.

It has been argued by the counsel for the applicant that though, there is an allegation in the FIR that Rajjanlal Srivastava vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko ... on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167211090/
1 the public fund has been misappropriated by the applicant, whereas he has taken a specific plea in para no. 16 of the bail application that he has deposited the amount of Rs. 17,30,616/- to the Manager ofWorld Ayush Foundation International Trust, Varanasi on 20.02.2010 and while filing the counter affidavit, the same has been admitted in para no. 9 thereof.

entities.text: Rajjanlal Srivastava vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He submits that in fact,
under some misconception, the present applicant has been implicated, though he was never involved in committing any offence.
He next submits that the charge-sheet has been filed and there is no complaint that the applicant has ever absconded.

He also submits that the applicant has no previous criminal history and, therefore, no further custodial interrogation is required in this matter, thus, submission is that the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
Learned AGA appearing for the State has submitted that in reply to para no. 16, the facts are admitted.

Considering the aforesaid submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and after perusal of material placed on record, it transpires that the applicant has cooperated in the investigation proceedings and the charge-sheet has been filed.

Further, the main allegation with respect to misappropriation of the alleged amount is not proved as the same is itself admitted by the State counsel that the applicant has deposited the amount alleged to be misappropriated to the Manager ofWorld Ayush Foundation International Trust, Varanasi on 20.02.2010.
Thus, no further custodial interrogation seems to be required.
